spec.title: Provenance: how the GLM worker contract was learned

p.PURPOSE: This record preserves the observations and contradictions from which the installed protocol was distilled. It is self-contained history, not a requirement to possess the original repository. Normative behavior lives in `ZAI-GLM-CLAUDE-PROTOCOL`.

facts.SOURCE-LAUNCHER-CAMPAIGN: The global package- actualization/refactoring campaign and its `SUBAGENT-LAUNCHERS` record supplied the worker lifecycle, cwd identity, file packets, observation, report and cleanup incidents.
facts.SOURCE-LIFECYCLE-CAMPAIGN: The lifecycle/extensions campaign's ChatGPT operating contract supplied later corrections: normal tool permissions, visible unstaged handoff, early reports, task-shaped turn budgets, plain long-run output, quota domains, exact-process recovery and parent acceptance.
facts.SOURCE-FRACTALITY: The fractality ignition campaign, delegation calculus and GLM-5.2/Turbo playbooks supplied capability routing, packet construction and historical model calibration.
facts.SOURCE-LIVE-LAUNCHERS: The installed `claudez.ps1` and disabled sibling launcher supplied the real provider environment, pass-through, state separation, model requests, timeout and token-file behavior.
facts.SOURCE-OWNER-BOOT: The owner boot ledger supplied the current launcher/model mapping, secret discipline, quality floor and the rule that task volume cannot justify a weaker design.

facts.RESOLVE-MODEL-NAME: Older prose names GLM-5.2 while the live launcher requests `glm-5.3[1m]`. The protocol separates configured request from terminally observed identity and keeps calibration versioned.
facts.RESOLVE-EFFORT: Older prose says effort is “max by construction”; the executable only requests a default 32k thinking budget and permits override. The package makes the request exact and refuses to claim effective effort without metadata.
facts.RESOLVE-LANES: Two installed scripts do not imply two usable lanes. Owner authorization, credentials, entitlement and live health are independent; the historical sibling was disabled and separately observed unavailable.
facts.RESOLVE-OUTPUT: Early launch practice streamed every JSON event through the parent. Large runs proved that ordinary output plus a durable report preserves evidence with far less context; JSON remains a short-probe or file-side option.
facts.RESOLVE-LIVENESS: File size and mtime were once used as liveness. Thinking telemetry and unrelated writes falsified both. The current protocol combines exact process state, last non-telemetry event, visible artifacts and report progress.
facts.RESOLVE-DONE: A grep hit for `TASK-DONE` can match the packet itself and a real process can terminate without that token. Terminal transport and deliverable existence are separate observations.
facts.RESOLVE-REPORT-TIME: A report written only at the end was repeatedly lost to turn caps, quota walls and stalled final turns. The current contract creates its skeleton after the first meaningful slice and records every unfinished gate as `PENDING`.
facts.RESOLVE-GIT: The old blanket “workers never run Git” rule hid useful history. The actual boundary is mutating/hidden Git state: read-only log/show/blame/status/diff are evidence; add/commit/stash/reset/ checkout/worktree/push remain forbidden.
facts.RESOLVE-PERMISSIONS: A narrow tool allow-list was once treated as safety. It instead blocked legitimate reasoning and tests. The current default gives normal tools and protects the reviewable handoff; restricted tools are an explicit experiment only.
facts.RESOLVE-TURNS: A fixed 40-turn budget and a “second follow-up means failure” rule did not survive broad cold work. Budgets are task-shaped; same-cwd continuation is preferred when retained context makes the bounded repair cheaper.
facts.RESOLVE-REVIEW: “Review is never delegated” and useful independent model review describe different authority. Advisory review may be commissioned; the parent cannot delegate its accepting verdict.
facts.RESOLVE-PROFILE: Web/tool restrictions observed in a fractality profile do not transfer to direct claudez. Restrictions remain attached to the launcher/profile that actually enforces them.
facts.RESOLVE-QUOTA: Concurrent workers on one credential share its quota window. A sibling credential may have a separate window but can independently lack entitlement. Each lane is probed; neither testimony transfers.

facts.INCIDENT-REPORT-LOSS: Useful code survived a turn-limit failure that occurred before the report. This produced the early-skeleton and incremental-evidence rule.
facts.INCIDENT-SHARED-429: Two concurrent broad runs received the same reset instant. This proved account-wide quota sharing rather than per-process allowance.
facts.INCIDENT-INITIAL-STALL: A fresh run created session state but emitted no assistant/tool event and changed no product file for a bounded window. The exact process was stopped and the task rerouted; no transport failure was mislabelled a code verdict.
facts.INCIDENT-FINAL-STALL: A completed diff and green narrow test survived a stalled final reasoning turn. Exact-PID stop plus same-cwd continuation preserved the work and finished the correction.
facts.INCIDENT-ZERO-TEST: A filtered Cargo command exited 0 while selecting zero tests. Acceptance now records counts and uses a positive control where selection could be empty.
facts.INCIDENT-PIPE-EXIT: Broad commands piped through grep/head/tail reported the pipeline member's exit rather than the gate's. The current contract captures the child status directly.
facts.INCIDENT-CWD-RETARGET: Persistent `cd` and orphaned worktree directories retargeted later commands or ancestor Git discovery. Scoped cwd and cleanup-after-process-death are now mandatory.
facts.INCIDENT-GREEN-NOT-ACCEPTED: Several polished, green GLM deliveries still contained containment, identity or vacuous-oracle defects. This is why the package preserves parent review rather than a model-specific trust shortcut.
facts.INCIDENT-PACKAGE-E2E: The first installed-package E2E on 2026-09-04 used the receipt-deployed PowerShell launcher in a fresh minimal project. A separate child ended successfully with a nonempty session id, terminal `modelUsage` named only `glm-5.3[1m]`, and the worker's own exact model report matched that key while producing the nonce-bound `GLM_E2E_OK` artifact. One pass was sufficient.

p.EXCLUDED: Repository-specific Cargo slot counts, wrapper scripts, line limits, cache/archive directories, branch naming, mirror cadence, campaign phase letters, provider billing assumptions, launcher enable/disable choices and central-model reserve thresholds remain host or campaign policy. They may be supplied in a packet but are not universal z.ai GLM launcher law.
